title: Had someone dump a bunch of AI feedback on indie games on my site and I had to put them in a corner.
author: getplaytests-dot-dev
selftext:
So I run a site that's dedicated to helping indie devs help each other for free. With increasing amounts of AI these days I have to make sure that the reviews and feedbacks that come in aren't literally just generated by AI itself. People can have their agents play strangers games and provide feedback without ever lifting a finger. That's not what I want. At the end of the day.. AI isn't the target audience of these people's games, so I'm not allowing their input to be accepted.

This is a lot of work for me to manually read these AI slops, but it's worth it when I get to see actual devs get great feedback from other actual devs. 

If you can't play someone's game the right way and give them notes that's useful then we don't want you here.

That's all.

comments.author: Timely_Spirit_9053
comments.body:
Why wouldnt someone want to play the game to try it out? I had the agent try to play my game just out of sheer curiousity how it would do and because i thought it was funny, but i would much rather prefer to try someone elses game myself and give feedback.

Whats the sites name? Are there conditions to uploading games?

replies.author: getplaytests-dot-dev
replies.body:
Because people are lazy especially with AI lol

You can upload any game you make. There are some things I check like whether it's on a site that requires me to download an exe or if it's on a trusted site or if it's playable on web, etc.

The site is https://getplaytests.dev

replies.author: Timely_Spirit_9053
replies.body: I checked FAQ but cant seem to find rules, what is the policy on games where ehh...a bit heavy amount of AI is used, but directed and tested frequently by me?

replies.author: getplaytests-dot-dev
replies.body: We accept AI games, we just don't accept AI playthroughs or AI feedback. If your game piques someone's interest then they'll play it.

replies.author: Timely_Spirit_9053
replies.body:
Fantastic

What does the 30s upload mean? Does it suggest the game demo must be minor?

replies.author: getplaytests-dot-dev
replies.body: Not sure what you're referring to do you want to send a picture or something?

replies.author: getplaytests-dot-dev
replies.body: Oh I see what you're saying now. The 30 seconds is referring to how long it takes for you to fill in the playtest form to get your game on the site. It's not about the demo size

replies.author: Timely_Spirit_9053
replies.body: I see, is there a file size limit? Can I upload in the form of Zip?

replies.author: getplaytests-dot-dev
replies.body: You'll have to upload your game to a trusted site like itch.io, steam or have it run in browser.

replies.author: Timely_Spirit_9053
replies.body: Sick, its already on Itch.io, i just want to do one more big update before i try, thank you!

replies.author: mallcopsarebastards
replies.body: right, but why would someone want to literally spend their own money to test a strangers game for free? This doesn't seem real to me. How do you know it was AI?

replies.author: getplaytests-dot-dev
replies.body: It's obvious when you read it. It's empty it has nothing in it except a bunch of words lol

replies.author: matt_williamson
replies.body: Agents probably play the games because the site has a token system connected to play-testing and feedback.

replies.body: Why? Especially if its for the sake of fun?
